items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: Well, that guy, I used to love to hear him play bass.

ctx.x: Oh, yes. I saw him in California. Yeah. Had a nice interview with him. Yeah. Yeah. Looks good. Same as ever. Yeah. Eddie Garland. He's more bald than I am. Is that so? He gets around good. He's about 70 years old.
Yeah. Eddie's up in age now. Yeah. But he's active. Yeah. Well, that guy, I used to love to hear him play bass. Yeah, he really slaps that.
Yeah. Yeah. Yeah, he, I think... Bill Johnson. Bill Johnson. I'm trying to find him again. I haven't seen him in years. I don't know what become of Bill.
